title: Brazil coach mistaken for pitch invader, put in headlock
html:
Brazil coach mistaken for pitch invader, put in headlock

Footage shows Parana Clube coach Tcheco being grabbed by security guard after celebrating a goal with fans during the Copa Parana final. The guard, who put the Brazilian coach in a headlock, had mistaken him for a pitch invader as he returned to the field.
summary: Footage shows Parana Clube coach Tcheco being grabbed by security guard after celebrating a goal with fans.
